class.name: YAMLSecurity
class.brief_description: Controls security policies for resource loading during YAML parsing.
class.description: [YAMLSecurity] manages restrictions on which resources can be loaded from YAML files using the [code]!Resource[/code] tag. It helps guard against unsafe loading of untrusted content by allowing control over allowed resource paths and types. Loading resources is limited to [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] root paths for security reasons. By default [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code] types are blocked, but you can allow them if needed using [method clear_type_restrictions].

method.name: allow_path
method.description:
Allows loading resources from paths matching [param path_prefix]. Use wildcards [code]*[/code] (single segment) and [code]**[/code] (any number of segments) for pattern matching. If [param type_names] is provided, only resources of those types will be allowed from this path. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Allow only textures from the mod folder security.allow_path("user://mods", ["Texture2D"])
# Parse mod configuration with custom security var mod_yaml = """ mod_info: name: Better Weapons version: 1.2 textures: sword: !Resource 'user://mods/better_weapons/sword.png' axe: !Resource 'user://mods/better_weapons/axe.png' """
var result = YAML.parse(mod_yaml, security) [/codeblock]

method.name: block_type
method.description:
Blocks a resource type globally. Any resources of this type will be rejected during YAML parsing. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Allow all resources from the game's resource folder security.allow_path("res://**")
# But scenes for security security.block_type("PackedScene") [/codeblock]

method.name: clear_path_restrictions
method.description: Removes all allowed path rules. No path-based restrictions will be enforced until [method allow_path] is used again.

method.name: clear_type_restrictions
method.description: Removes all blocked resource types, including default blocks on [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code]. This is potentially dangerous with untrusted content.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets all rules to default values. Clears any custom path rules and blocks [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code] types.
